faq: How much does it cost to wrap a car in Columbus, Ohio?

A full colour change starts at {$wrap.full} for a coupe or sedan, {$wrap.full.1} for an SUV or truck and {$wrap.full.2} for a van or large SUV. Colour-shift and specialty films start at {$wrap.shift}. Roofs, hoods and chrome delete are priced on their own.
How long does a car wrap last?
Film makers rate quality cast vinyl for about five to seven years outdoors. Garage parking and hand washing get you the long end of that.
Is a wrap cheaper than a paint job?
For a colour change of the same quality, usually yes. A wrap also comes off, so the factory paint is still there underneath.
What window tint is legal in Ohio?
Front side windows must let at least 50% of light through. Rear side windows and the back glass can be any darkness. On the windshield, only a strip across the top five inches can be dark.
How much is paint protection film?
A partial front starts at {$ppf.partial}, a full front at {$ppf.front} and full body at {$ppf.full} for a coupe or sedan.
Can I see it on my own car first?
Yes. Upload a photo and pick a finish, and we send your car back in that finish with your price.
Do you wrap business vehicles?
Yes. Vans, box trucks, buses, food trucks and boats, from door lettering at {$fleet.lettering} to full printed wraps. See the commercial page.
Where are you?
We work in the Columbus area by appointment, with customers from Dublin, Hilliard and the rest of central Ohio. Book and we send the details with your price.

faq: How much does a commercial vehicle wrap cost?

Door logos and lettering start at {$fleet.lettering}. A partial wrap starts at {$fleet.partial}, a full van wrap at {$fleet.van}, a box truck at {$fleet.box} and a food truck or trailer at {$fleet.foodtruck}.
Do you design the graphics?
Yes. Send the logo and the vehicle list. Design starts at {$fleet.design} and the proof comes back with your price.
Can you match one design across different vehicles?
Yes. The design is laid out per vehicle so the brand reads the same on a van, a box truck and a trailer.
How long does a fleet wrap last?
Printed and laminated wraps are made to last years of daily use. Up to about seven is typical for a vehicle that is washed regularly.
How long are the vehicles off the road?
Installing a wrap on a van or box truck usually takes two to three days. For a fleet we stagger the vehicles so the work keeps moving.
Can you wrap a leased van?
Yes. A wrap comes off without marking sound factory paint, which is why leased fleets are wrapped and not painted.
Do you do food trucks, trailers and boats?
Yes. All three are in our work, including a full colour change and custom design on a food truck in Dublin.
